Subject: Steering committee / exec sponsor sync - next steps & SOC2/Qs

Hi Sofia / Ethan —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment before scheduling the steering committee with your exec sponsor(s):

- Use case: customer support automation + contextual retrieval for knowledge base (primary).
- Key decision criteria: latency (<300ms p95), token/unit cost, and security controls (KMS + SOC2).
- Current blockers: procurement wants SOC2 evidence + data residency notes; security needs KMS/HSM integration details.
- Timeline: target pilot start in Q2 (late April) if steering committee signs off.

Next steps I propose:
1) Identify the steering committee attendees (economic buyer, security lead, procurement). Can you confirm names/roles?
2) Share our compact steering committee deck (attached) and a short agenda.
3) We’ll prepare SOC2 artifact summary and a short note on private deployment/KMS options for your legal/security teams.
4) Book a 30-minute steering committee slot — I included a Calendly link below but happy to take options.

Attachments: Steering_Committee_Deck.pdf (summary + proposed agenda)

If that works, response with the attendee names and two available windows next week and I’ll coordinate Rishi (account lead) and Laura (solutions engineer) to join.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Thanks Marissa. Quick commercial preview:
- Pilot estimate: 4-week pilot, up to 50k generated tokens/day average; estimated monthly inference cost (hosted) approx $8k–$10k depending on batching/quantization choices. We’ll present a committed Dedicated option for predictable unit economics if that’s the direction.
- Proposed commercial ask for steering committee: approval to proceed with pilot (budget sign-off) and procurement contact to finalize SOW.

I’ve added a short budget line to the deck and will include a simple decision checklist for the steering committee (cost, security sign-off, pilot KPIs).

See you Wed 2026-03-18 09:00 PT. I’ll bring the commercial slides.

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi team —

Attaching the two items I promised: 1) one-slide network diagram for a Private VPC deployment (filename: network_diagram.png stub) and 2) SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf (attached). These are high-level pre-reads — I’ll bring the deeper technical detail to the meeting.

Quick notes:
- KMS options: we support customer-managed keys via major cloud KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) and can integrate with customer HSMs via standard KMIP flows in Private.
- Logs & retention: logs can be configured to forward to your S3/GCS/Azure storage with configurable retention; we can support 3-year retention for audit exports.
- Network: Private VPC + Private control plane option is available for regulated deployments; we’ll present the deployment flow during the sync.

Attachments: network_diagram.png, SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf

Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
